crossRefs.note: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who ruled over the people…
He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three…
These were the chief officers of king Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

parallels.note: These were the chief officers of king Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.
translations.bsb: They were also the chief officers over Solomon’s projects: 550 supervisors over the people who did the work.
translations.kjv: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
translations.asv: These were the chief officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, who bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
